name: BanHate: An Up-to-Date and Fine-Grained Bangla Hate Speech Dataset
description: BanHate is an up-to-date and fine-grained Bangla hate speech dataset comprising 19,203 YouTube comments collected between April 2024 and June 2025. Presented at BLP-2025, each comment is annotated for binary hate speech, seven fine-grained hate categories, and seven demographic target groups to support nuanced content moderation in Bengali online discourse.
